import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_4.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames vertically
Target5_1 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
Target5_1.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all sources
df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3, source4], ignore_index=True)

# Filter out rows where all columns are NaN
df = df.dropna(how='all')

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_1/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
